activities.title: OOP Concept Map
activities.instruction: Explore the main concepts used in Python object-oriented programming.

content.concept: OOP organizes programs around objects that combine state and behavior. Classes define the structure and behavior that objects can have.
content.tip: Interact with the example first. Your progress is saved for this session.

activities.title: Class Anatomy
activities.instruction: Explore the parts of a Python class.

content.concept: A class can contain class attributes, instance attributes, methods, and an initializer such as __init__ for setting initial object state.

activities.title: OOP Principle Explorer
activities.instruction: Choose the OOP principle illustrated by each scenario.
